learning_curve_validation_minimum.interpretation: operational rule, not a statistical-power guarantee

synthetic_label_control.procedure: Fit M2 and selected M3/M4 at Stage 7 fixed penalties and representation; independent fair-coin fitting and validation labels.
synthetic_label_control.investigation_trigger: At least 16 of 20 accepted repetitions improve over the 0.5 baseline for any tested procedure; this is an operational flag, not proof of leakage.

ablation_notes: Age remains in the Y representation in all registered ablations. Numeric missing indicators follow their parent variable. Refit M3 on the unchanged matched fitting/validation responses; recompute the retained block RMS norm on unique fitting photos after dropping one group.
